title: dactylorhiza sphagnicola f. sennia
intro: Dactylorhiza sphagnicola f. sennia, commonly known as Marsh Orchid, is a rare and unique plant species that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, particularly in treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The Marsh Orchid has been reported to possess therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Dactylorhiza sphagnicola f. sennia include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
